attempts.root_cause: The TMS worker preload library could not resolve libcudart.so.12.
attempts.remediation: Propagate the pinned venv CUDA runtime directory through every AReaL scheduling spec.

attempts.root_cause: Pinned SGLang read Qwen3_5Config.vocab_size, while the composite model exposes it under text_config.vocab_size.
attempts.remediation: Use the existing SGLang-only model overlay to expose seven text config dimensions without changing actor weights.

attempts.root_cause: The OPD config reserved only mem_fraction_static=0.45, below the existing Qwen3.5-4B SGLang recipe's 0.55 allocation.
attempts.remediation: Reuse the repository's proven Qwen3.5-4B SGLang mem_fraction_static=0.55 setting.

attempts.root_cause: The 8k Qwen3.5-4B cache setting mem_fraction_static=0.55 was still insufficient for the frozen 16k OPD context contract.
attempts.remediation: Use the repository's higher-context Qwen3.5 SGLang allocation mem_fraction_static=0.65 while retaining the 79 GiB guard.

attempts.root_cause: The colocated single-rank FSDP actor was already offloaded when AReaL broadcast locally available RPC metadata over its paused CUDA/NCCL communicator.
attempts.runtime_progress: M2 actor, frozen 9B teacher, SGLang overlay, M2 LoRA, CUDA graphs, and the 16k rollout server all initialized successfully before the RPC failure.
attempts.remediation: Skip redundant RPC payload broadcast only when the initialized context/model-parallel group has world size one; retain upstream behavior for every multi-rank engine.

attempts.failure_stage: AReaL initial offload policy after actor-rollout connection
attempts.root_cause: AReaL offloaded the colocated FSDP actor before SGLang initialization and then called FSDPEngine.offload a second time; torch_memory_saver aborted on the inactive allocation.
attempts.native_error: Cannot pause allocation that is not active
attempts.runtime_progress: The single-rank RPC bridge passed connect_engine; all model and rollout components initialized before the duplicate offload.
attempts.remediation: Make FSDPEngine.offload idempotent only inside the StudyHub OPD runtime, preserving the upstream transition whenever the engine is resident.

attempts.failure_stage: AReaL AgentWorkflow proxy initialization after initial rollout offload
attempts.root_cause: Pinned AReaL applied the colocated rollout offload policy before lazily starting Hermes proxy workers; proxy initialization then health-checked an intentionally offloaded SGLang server and timed out.
attempts.native_error: Inference server failed to become healthy within 300 seconds after release_memory_occupation
attempts.runtime_progress: Actor, frozen teacher, SGLang, M2 LoRA, connect_engine, and the idempotent actor offload bridge all passed before proxy startup waited on the offloaded server.
attempts.remediation: For the first proxy start only, temporarily onload the colocated rollout for proxy health binding and restore the original offloaded state before the upstream train loop begins.

claim_boundary: No recorded attempt produced a reward batch, optimizer update, passing LR marker, or OPD model result.
